title: A17 Controller Calibration Sensitivity and Risk Bounds Specification

A17_A.name: calibration_error_theorem_test
A17_A.comparison_authorization: AUTHORIZED: Only A17-A may be compared against the analytic 2 * L_ctrl * epsilon_cal bound under Theorem 2 assumptions.
A17_A.description: Evaluates worst-case empirical one-step regret induced solely by calibration estimation error epsilon_cal under a fixed declared cost/harm model.

A17_B.name: cost_and_harm_sensitivity
A17_B.comparison_authorization: STRICTLY_PROHIBITED: A17-B sensitivity must NEVER be compared against the A17-A analytic calibration error bound (2 * L_ctrl * epsilon_cal) as no theorem applies across disparate candidate models.
A17_B.description: Exploration of action frontiers, policy-switch rates, and model-relative regret against the per-theta oracle across varied objective regimes.

separation_guarantee.description: A17-A calibration error analysis and A17-B parametric sensitivity are strictly quarantined. Unit tests and verification scripts enforce that A17-B outputs cannot invoke analytic theorem bound checks.
